dataset_metadata.disclaimer: New AI-generated English drafts of the recorded Classical Chinese; not scholarly reviewed. Original source interpretations are not verified geometry or modern etymology.

shuowen:7801.text: To push. Formed from 手, with 襄 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7802.text: To bring the hands together. Formed from 手, with 共 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7803.text: To bring the hands together in salutation. Formed from 手, with 僉 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7804.text: To bring the head to the ground. Formed from 手 and 𠦪. 𠦪 is pronounced like 忽.

shuowen:7805.text: To draw out, as in 搯捾. Formed from 手, with 官 indicating the sound. Alternatively, to pull or assist.

shuowen:7806.text: To draw out. Formed from 手, with 舀 indicating the sound. The Book of Zhou says: 'The army then drew weapons.' 搯 means drawing weapons to practice striking and thrusting. The Odes says: 'Turn left and draw to the right.'

shuowen:7807.text: To push or block. Formed from 手, with 𢀜 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7808.text: To push. Formed from 手, with 隹 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7809.text: To push. Formed from 手, with 夋 indicating the sound. The Spring and Autumn Commentary says: 'He pushed the marquis of Wei's hand.'

shuowen:7810.text: To push or crowd. Formed from 手, with 非 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7811.text: To push or crowd. Formed from 手, with 齊 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7812.text: To push against. Formed from 手, with 氐 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7813.text: To push or crush. Formed from 手, with 崔 indicating the sound. Alternatively, to push and pull; alternatively, to break.

shuowen:7814.text: To crush. Formed from 手, with 立 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7815.text: To crush or break. Formed from 手, with 𡋲 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7816.text: To assist. Formed from 手, with 夫 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7817.text: To support. Formed from 手, with 爿 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7818.text: To grasp. Formed from 手, with 寺 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7819.text: To hold suspended. Formed from 手, with 㓞 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7820.text: To hold fast by constraint. Formed from 手, with 甘 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7821.text: To count while holding. Formed from 手, with 枼 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7822.text: To grasp and hold. Formed from 手 and 執.

shuowen:7823.text: To grasp and hold. Formed from 手, with 喿 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7824.text: To hold with the claws or fingers. Formed from 手, with 瞿 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7825.text: To seize a garment's lapel tightly. Formed from 手, with 金 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7826.text: To seek and seize. Alternatively, to reach. Formed from 手, with 尃 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7827.text: To support oneself on a staff. Formed from 手, with 豦 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7828.text: To draw toward oneself and hold. Formed from 手, with 聶 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7829.text: To hold together. Formed from 手, with 冄 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7830.text: To feel and hold. Formed from 手, with 布 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7831.text: To hold at one's side, apparently. Formed from 手, with 夾 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7832.text: To stroke and hold. Formed from 手, with 門 indicating the sound. The Odes says: 'Do not touch my tongue.'

shuowen:7833.text: To grasp and hold. Formed from 手, with 監 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7834.text: To arrange and hold. Formed from 手, with 巤 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7835.text: To grip tightly. Formed from 手, with 屋 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7836.text: To lift and hold. Formed from 手, with 單 indicating the sound. Read like 驒 in 行遟驒驒, 'moving slowly.'

shuowen:7837.text: To grasp. Formed from 手, with 巴 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7838.text: To grasp. Formed from 手, with 鬲 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7839.text: To pull and draw. Formed from 手, with 奴 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7840.text: To carry or lift. Formed from 手, with 雟 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7841.text: To lift or carry. Formed from 手, with 是 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7842.text: To pinch or pick up. Formed from 手, with 𦔮 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7843.text: To pinch or pick up. Formed from 手, with 占 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7844.text: To spread out. Formed from 手, with 离 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7845.text: To release. Formed from 手, with 舍 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7846.text: To press with one finger. Formed from 手, with 厭 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7847.text: To press down. Formed from 手, with 安 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7848.text: To draw or pull. Formed from 手, with 空 indicating the sound. The Odes says: 'Draw toward the great state.' The Xiongnu call drawing a bow 控弦.

shuowen:7849.text: To rub or stroke. Formed from 手, with 盾 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7850.text: To follow along. Formed from 手, with 彖 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7851.text: To pat or stroke. Formed from 手, with 百 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7852.text: To rub or stroke. Formed from 手, with 付 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7853.text: To grasp. Today the salt administration calls entering the water to gather salt 掊. Formed from 手, with 咅 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7854.text: To take easily. Formed from 手, with 寽 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7855.text: To arrange or put in order. Formed from 手, with 尞 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7856.text: To place. Formed from 手, with 昔 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7857.text: To pierce flesh. Formed from 手 and 臿.

shuowen:7858.text: To select. Formed from 手, with 侖 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7859.text: To pick and select. Formed from 手, with 睪 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7860.text: To seize. Formed from 手, with 足 indicating the sound. Alternatively, to grasp.

shuowen:7861.text: To seize. Formed from 手, with 益 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7862.text: Long or extended. Formed from 手 and 延; 延 also indicates the sound.

shuowen:7863.text: To pluck or tear away. Formed from 手, with 前 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7864.text: To seize or pluck, as in 㧗. Formed from 手, with 烕 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7865.text: To seize, as in 捽. Formed from 手, with 此 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7866.text: To seize. Formed from 手, with 卽 indicating the sound. In 魏 commandery there is a marquisate called 揤裴.

shuowen:7867.text: To seize the hair of the head. Formed from 手, with 卒 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7868.text: Four 圭 measures. Alternatively, to pinch with two fingers. Formed from 手, with 最 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7869.text: To pinch or gather. Formed from 手, with abbreviated 𥷤 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7870.text: To pinch and take. Formed from 手, with 帶 indicating the sound. Read like 螮 in the Odes' 'The rainbow is in the east.'

shuowen:7871.text: To pull toward oneself and take. Formed from 手, with 孚 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7872.text: East of the Pass, taking is called 揜. Alternatively, to cover. Formed from 手, with 弇 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7873.text: To give. Formed from 手 and 受; 受 also indicates the sound.

shuowen:7874.text: To offer up; to receive. Formed from 手, 卪, and 𠬞.

shuowen:7875.text: To supply. Formed from 手, with 臣 indicating the sound. Alternatively, to bind or restrain.

shuowen:7876.text: To wipe. Formed from 手, with 堇 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7877.text: To form a group of companions. Formed from 手, with 黨 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7878.text: To join. Formed from 手, with 妾 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7879.text: To wipe. Formed from 手, with 巿 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7880.text: To push and pull. The Han has an official called 挏馬, who makes mare's-milk liquor. Formed from 手, with 同 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7881.text: To beckon with the hand. Formed from 手 and 召.

shuowen:7882.text: To soothe. Formed from 手, with 無 indicating the sound. Alternatively, to stroke along.

shuowen:7883.text: To stroke. Formed from 手, with 昏 indicating the sound. Alternatively, to copy.

shuowen:7884.text: To measure. Formed from 手, with 耑 indicating the sound. Measuring height is called 揣. Alternatively, to strike it.

shuowen:7885.text: To open. Formed from 手, with 只 indicating the sound. Read like 抵 in 抵掌.

shuowen:7886.text: To become accustomed. Formed from 手, with 貫 indicating the sound. The Spring and Autumn Commentary says: 'Habitually profaning the ghosts and spirits.'

shuowen:7887.text: To throw. Formed from 手 and 殳.

shuowen:7888.text: To scratch. Formed from 手, with 適 indicating the sound. Alternatively, to throw.

shuowen:7889.text: To scrape. Formed from 手, with 蚤 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7890.text: To scrape. Formed from 手, with 介 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7891.text: To strike. Formed from 手, with 票 indicating the sound. Alternatively, to lift a gate-bolt.

shuowen:7892.text: To disturb or stir. Formed from 手, with 兆 indicating the sound. Alternatively, to agitate. The Discourses of the States says: “Xi Zhi challenged Heaven.”

shuowen:7893.text: To pick or pry. Formed from 手, with 夬 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7894.text: To disturb. Formed from 手, with 堯 indicating the sound. Alternatively, to gather or rescue, as in 捄.

shuowen:7895.text: To trouble or vex. Formed from 手, with 夒 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7896.text: To brace and hold, as in 𢧢持. Formed from 手, with 局 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7897.text: To brace and support, as in 𢧢挶. Formed from 手, with 居 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7898.text: To scrape. Formed from 手, with 葛 indicating the sound. Alternatively, to beat.

shuowen:7899.text: To pick fruit from a tree. Formed from 手, with 啻 indicating the sound. Alternatively, to point and bring it close.

shuowen:7900.text: To scrape. Formed from 手, with 害 indicating the sound.
